messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about Community, urban and rural life, Cultural activities and participation, Political behaviour and attitudes, Government, political systems and organisations, and Housing in North Rhine-Westphalia during the 2000s, matching this research need: survey data on Duisburg residents’ housing conditions and satisfaction, local economic perceptions, municipal administration and politics, public services, leisure activities, museum use, transport, and demographic characteristics
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.
